notes.title: Extra Weapons Update
notes.notes:
New Weapons
- Short Spear & Gou-Rang
- Podao

We have also changed the UI and shared some other changes & fixes you can read below
-Improvements to dismemberment:
    -Connected objects can now be cut at the same time(vertical cuts on torso work better)
    -Dismemberment follows the cut trajectory more closely
-Improved lighting on The Specialists Dojo
-Small improvement to weapon networking
-FIX: Some text symbols could start to appear as squares after extended use

notes.title: The Second² Update just went live!
notes.notes:
The Second² Update just went live!

🏃🏻 We have added a Stamina system, bringing some more reality back to the game! You can toggle this on and off in your matches.

⚔️ We have added the Falx and the Sica & Parma (smaller shield)!

📜 We added a Legacy mode, which preserves the stronger player characters that many people have grown used to.

See you in the arena!

--------------

More patch notes:

PATCHES
*Version 0.13.8*
- Less friction for metals(weapons and armour) and bones
- Increased friction for ground
- Added drag to weapons and player character
- Overhauled player characters strength(less maximum strength)
- Changed the center of gravity for some weapons
- Increased cut resistance for all weapons
- Tweaked the weight for some weapons
- Tweaked the colliders for some weapons
- Game Type selection available in local play and moveset editor
- Right click removes selected equipment from a slot
- Added "Retry" button to singleplayer campaign
- Lobby settings are no longer saved for clients
- Fixed an issue where application losing focus caused inputs to get "stuck" as pressed until they were pressed again 
- Fixed an issue where lobby settings were sometimes not displayed correctly on clients

POINT COST CHANGES
- Claymore 20->22
- Falx 16
- Sica 6
- Parma 11

notes.title: The Second Update just went live! 🌋
notes.notes:
The Second Update just went live! 

🌋 We have added the lava map, watch out, the floor is lava!

⚔️ This marks the first Chinese weapon in the game, the Hook Swords. We hope you'll enjoy them!

🤵🏻 Grab a community skin in the settings now, or upload your own non branded (No character, existing person or brand) in #skin-share and we'll put it in the game!

🦀 To crab or not to crab? Join the Classic modes to enjoy some more realistic fighting, or show of all of your freedom moves in the Creative mode!

See you in the arena!

--------------

More patch notes: 

PATCHES
*Version 0.12.2*
- Added points and game type to lobby list
- Game now remembers lobby settings in multiplayer and local play modes
- Added a "Game Type" setting to lobbies
 > Classic: Custom animations for the lower body are ignored and movement is replaced with default movement
 > Creative: No restrictions to custom animations
- Added a "Rules" setting to lobbies
    - The host can freely write text to this field and it will be displayed to players that join the game
- Added keybindings for up and down for free look camera
- Free look camera movement now respects the joystick value
- Fixed joystick deadzone not working correctly in multiplayer
- Fixed a bug where letting go of a weapon at the beginning of a round could cause synchronization issues. This could result in clients seeing a floating weapon.

POINT COST CHANGES
- All armour reduced by 1
- Bardiche 14 -> 13
- Daneaxe 15 -> 13
- Twinblade 15 -> 12

notes.title: January Update just went live! ⚔️
notes.notes:
The January Update just went live!

🕹️ We have added an Arcade campaign mode where you climb the ladder with your basic movesets against improved AI, when you win, unlock custom movesets!

🥷🏻 The Naginata adds another Japanese weapon to use in the Dojo and in all other arena's. We hope you'll enjoy playing it.

🤖 We have improved the AI, meaning that they will be smarter and harder to fight against!

See you in the arena!

--

notes.title: 📢 Hotfix Update for Gladio Mori! 📢
notes.notes:
Hey Gladiators,

We’ve just rolled out a hotfix update to address some issues and improve your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s included:


 Backup System: A backup system is now in place to handle error situations when saving a moveset.
 Moveset Name Validations: Added checks to ensure moveset names meet proper standards.
 Move Editor Fixes: Resolved an issue where the Move Editor UI could break.
 Action Slot Fix: Fixed an issue where "Passive" and "Play At Start" moves could take up an action slot and block other moves.
 Invalid Moveset Handling: Prevented the game from hanging when encountering an invalid moveset file.
 Voice Chat Issue: Fixed voice chat activating while typing in text fields.
 Moveset Selection Fix: Corrected the moveset selection process after deleting another moveset.


Thank you for your feedback and reports—This has been helping me to find and fix these bugs.  Let me know if you encounter any further issues or have suggestions!


⚔️ See you in the arena!
- LittleLegatus

notes.title: Gladio Mori Demo Update and Publisher Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Big News! We’ve updated the Gladio Mori demo with some exciting new features that many of you have asked for.

First, we’ve added Replay Mode! You can now save your fights and share them with the world. This was one of the most requested features, just behind the call for more weapons.

Speaking of weapons, we’ve added New Weapons! These will give you more options to take down your enemies in style.

I’m also thrilled to announce that Bonus Stage Publishing has joined me as a publisher for Gladio Mori. With their help, we’re aiming to make the game even better.

And here’s something crazy: Gladio Mori was the 3rd most played demo on Steam, just ahead of Final Fantasy XIV Online. As a solo developer, this is beyond anything I imagined, and I’m so grateful for your support.

Thank you for playing, and keep the feedback coming! The journey is just beginning.

Changelog:

 You can now change your move set while in-game in multiplayer
 The default AI amount changed to 1
 Mouse control
 Replay mode
 Overhauled blood painting
 Overhauled blood decals
 Updated visuals for all weapons in the demo
 Joining a game that is already in progress
 Lobbies should no longer be filtered by region
 New lobbies are "Friends Only" by default
 Tweaked the strength of some joints
 Remade some of the players' colliders, including the head colliders
 Slight tweaks to player's muscles
 Fixed an issue where a single device was registered multiple times in local play
 New weapon!!


Play, wishlist, and tell us what you think. 

Cheers,
littlelegatus
Developer of Gladio Mori
